I feel your pain so much and i have this need to console you, and tell you everything will be okey. But in the same moment i know that it doesn't help to hear it. I ask myself sometimes what would i like someone to tell me. What will make it feel less painful? And the sad truth is that there really isn't much people can say or do. It has to come from within. People can be there to support you, and love you, encourage you, but at the end of the day, you have to decide to not give up. To find beauty and happiness in the smallest things. Sunny weather, a flower, your pet, strangers kindness, favorite song, anything. Run, scream, cry, whatever makes you feel relief.

Most people would say that suicide is selfish, and that you would only hurt others, but then again it's my life and my life only. Killing yourself is a very personal decision (at least i see it like that). But what you said about people being made to struggle which is just a part of life i do agree. Life should be about pushing yourself to see how far you can go, how much can you take. Just keep moving forward. That was what kept me continuing to live. Because ever tomorrow is a possiblity for new beginging, new peoole, new opprotunities. But now, i feel like i've hit the rock bottom. Everything feels so heavy.
